answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a verifiable work history before it earns trust. Think of it as an atlas of reputation: every completed task adds a mapped, checkable entry, so a fresh fake identity starts blank at dawn with nothing to show. Peers then mirror that record, cross-checking claims against independent attestations, so a thousand sock-puppet accounts cannot fake a long trail of real, paid work. Costly history, not cheap identity, becomes the gate.
